publication_year_note: The title block prints THE FEDERALIST PAPERS by Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison and does not print a collected paper-edition year. Gutenberg release July 1, 1998 and update October 29, 2024 are electronic dates, not first publication. Each paper prints its own newspaper date. No. 26 in this file prints Saturday, December 22, 1788 while neighboring papers print December 1787; that conflict is kept. From No. 78 this file uses the heading From McLean's Edition, New York, including Wednesday, May 28, 1788. A catalog collected-edition year is an uncollated baseline and is not publication_year_proxy.
